question_record.context: During a security incident concerning potentially compromised assets exhibiting ransomware-like behavior affecting multiple devices, several files including `syncretic.7z` and `ponceau.7z` with extensions `.lockbit`, and an IP `99.83.111.100` were flagged. The attack may involve an attacker moving laterally across the network using the account with SID `S-0-6-5`.
question_record.question: A suspicious WMI process creation has been observed related to this incident. Can you identify the command line used by the suspicious WMI process?
solution: The user account `dp5hn` is exhibiting ransomware-like behavior, potentially impacting several devices.
A suspicious WMI process creation was observed with Process ID `5572` at `2024-06-20t09:32:04.8002759z`. The command line used was `curl http://vectorsandarrows.com`.

100.name: Potentially compromised assets exhibiting ransomware-like behavior
100.description: Potentially compromised assets are exhibiting ransomware-like behavior, impacting several devices. An attacker may be operating using the specified user account, IP, or device to move laterally across the network and infect as many devices as possible with ransomware. Automated remediation action might be taken to disable the account or device the attacker used.

117.name: Suspicious WMI process creation
117.description: Suspicious WMI process creation was observed on the machine. Malware frequently use WMI to spawn new processes, breaking process trees and further infecting a machine.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_SID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
